full_details: At half past seven you called him from Great St Helen's. He took the joy as a wife, a full cradle, a house that does not smoke, and a company eleven pound richer of a Thursday. You did not write the eleven pounds. Seven sharers' hose, and the hired men's, before the old lord looks. Mistress Pope has let Arthur's hems down twice since Michaelmas, and there is no more hem. Nick's doublet wants easing at the chest, which Nick will not discuss. The voice holds if he is not startled. Tomorrow they choose the three plays, and he wants no surprises. At nine the book on the peg was the cut book. You are Gaunt. Three leaves stayed under the book. You did not play a deposition. At two you played him through. At home the chest was still shut. A small fierce girl against a tall one: Nick, and Arthur, who has the lines in case. Nobody tells Nick.
one_sentence: You gave John joy of his day by the item, and you played Gaunt in the cut book.
title: John's joy, by the item
